title: Cantonese Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and comforting noodle soup inspired by Cantonese flavors.

ingredients.name: in a pinch of soy sauce
veggies
ingredients.notes: cantonese mix of cabbage, carrots, and green onions

instructions: Boil a large pot of water and cook the lo mein noodles according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the lo mein sauce and soy sauce over medium heat.
Add the veggies and cook until they are tender.
Combine the cooked noodles and the veggie mixture in the pan.
Season with the package seasoning provided.
